openQuestion: The last candidate scored an otherwise unsupported coefficient as an own fit whenever the submission named no competing source. Its criterion elsewhere required a traceable link to the measured fit. The source of a coefficient, including 9.81 m/s², cannot be inferred from the number alone.
precedingBorderline: Version 23 had two upper bounds for a law based on the first fit after further runs were supplied. Evidence that the initial fit represents the whole series can change the final synthesis credit even when the equation text stays the same.
recommendationForPrC: Review how to distinguish the evidence from each of the two own investigations from the final interpretation across runs. Decide where a joint fit and a law tied to the series estimate belong before deriving a shorter marking scheme.
